library.session.recoveryFailed.zh-CN: 图书馆登录状态未能恢复，请先重试；若仍失败，请在设置中重新登录
library.session.recoveryFailed.en-US: Your library session could not be restored. Try again; if it still fails, sign in again in Settings.

library.session.unavailable.zh-CN: 暂时无法连接图书馆账号，请重试；若仍失败，请在设置中重新登录
library.session.unavailable.en-US: Your library account could not be connected. Try again; if it still fails, sign in again in Settings.

library.session.expired.zh-CN: 图书馆登录状态已失效，请重试
library.session.expired.en-US: Your library session has expired. Please try again.
